Name: Lahmi
Summary: Brother of Goliath the Gittite, slain by Elhanan son of Jair.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 20:5: Brother of Goliath the Gittite, slain by Elhanan son of Jair.
LifeLesson: The mention of Lahmi in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
